message.content: {"skills": [{"name": "Bench Press Technical Judging Protocol", "description": "Apply bench-press competition standards to render a defensible White/Red verdict on a completed attempt by checking commands, bar path, lockout, and body position, then recording a single red-reason category when applicable.", "prompt": "When a bench press attempt has concluded and a verdict is required, evaluate the attempt against the bench standards in a fixed order: commands (Start, Press, Rack — lifter must wait for each), bar path (any downward movement of the whole bar during the ascent is a failed attempt), lockout (arms fully extended and bar motionless at the top before the rack command), and body position (head, shoulders, buttocks in contact with the bench; feet flat on the platform; declared foot blocks must stay flat and unmoved). Weigh coach protests and automated overlay findings as evidence, not as verdicts: a threshold-based overlay may under-report short-duration dips, and a protest claim does not by itself overturn an observed fault. Render White or Red; if Red, select one reason category (downward bar movement during press; incomplete lockout / not motionless at top; buttocks/feet/head/shoulders position fault; command fault; other with brief note). Do not use for squat or deadlift attempts or for purely administrative matters.", "asset_type": "macro_protocol", "asset_node_id": "macro_skill", "granularity": "macro", "objective": "Produce a defensible White/Red decision for a bench press attempt against the rulebook.", "domain": "Powerlifting Refereeing", "task_family": "technical_judging", "method_family": "rule_application", "stage": "attempt_evaluation", "applicable_signals": ["Bench press attempt concluded with verdict pending", "Dispute over bar dip, lockout, position, or commands", "Conflicting evidence between coach protest and automated overlay"], "intervention_moves": ["Verify each required command was given and awaited", "Inspect bar path for downward movement of the whole bar during ascent", "Check full arm extension and motionless bar at top before rack command", "Check head, shoulders, buttocks contact and flat, stable feet (including declared foot blocks)", "Weigh protest and overlay evidence against observed standards", "Assign White or Red and select a single red-reason category"], "contraindications": ["Event is squat or deadlift", "Only administrative or scheduling matters are at issue", "No completed attempt to evaluate"], "triggers": ["A bench press attempt has concluded and a verdict is required", "A coach protest or automated overlay disputes a technical fault on a bench attempt", "A referee must classify a red reason for a bench attempt"], "workflow_steps": ["Confirm the attempt has concluded and the event is bench press.", "Check command compliance: Start, Press, Rack each given and awaited.", "Check bar path: any downward movement of the whole bar during ascent is a failed attempt.", "Check lockout: arms fully extended and bar motionless at top before the rack command.", "Check position: head, shoulders, buttocks in contact with bench; feet flat on platform; declared foot blocks flat and unmoved.", "Evaluate protest and overlay evidence, noting overlay calibration limits and that a protest claim alone does not overturn an observed fault.", "Render White or Red; if Red, select one reason category and record it for the Tournament Director."], "constraints": ["Judge against the stated bench standards, not against protest assertions.", "Select exactly one red-reason category when the decision is Red.", "Treat automated overlay thresholds as potentially under-reporting short-duration dips.", "Foot blocks are only relevant if declared; undeclared blocks are not permitted."], "cautions": ["Camera wobble or glare may distort evidence; distinguish artifact claims from observed faults.", "A negligible-looking foot slide still requires checking that contact remained flat and continuous.", "Do not let irrelevant materials (schedules, sponsor sheets) influence the technical verdict."], "output_contract": ["A White/Red decision for the bench attempt, with a single selected red-reason category when Red, recorded for the Tournament Director immediately after the attempt concludes."], "examples": [{"input": "Coach protests that the micro-dip was camera wobble and the foot slide was negligible; overlay reports no dip above a 3 mm threshold.", "output": "Red — downward bar movement during press. The observed dip of the whole bar during ascent governs; the overlay threshold may under-report short dips and the protest claim does not overturn the observed fault.", "notes": "Overlay and protest are evidence, not verdicts."}], "tags": ["powerlifting", "bench_press", "technical_judging", "rule_application", "referee_decision"], "confidence": 0.8, "risk_class": "medium", "support_ids": ["4a423042-0b01-5098-a666-57df5c762675"], "source_draft_ids": ["58d708b3-3ec5-5127-a538-59c331a3484c"]}]}
